create_gemma3n_multimodal_model: create a Gemma3nForConditionalGeneration model that processes text, image, and audio inputs for multimodal generation
run_gemma3n_text_inference: run text inference with Gemma3nForCausalLM using input_ids and optional past_key_values for cached decoding

process_multimodal_inputs: process multimodal inputs by embedding vision and audio features into language model space with Gemma3nMultimodalEmbedder
